body:
npm refused the first publish of `gh-upload`:

```
403 Forbidden - PUT https://registry.npmjs.org/gh-upload - Package name too similar to existing package rc-upload
```

This switches the npm package to `gh-upload-file`, the alternative named in #37 (free on npm).
- The `gh-upload` command is unchanged, and a `gh-upload-file` command is added for `npx gh-upload-file`.
- `gh-upload-log` keeps publishing alongside.
- README install and import lines, tests and the changeset are updated.

`bun test`: 181 pass. `bun run check` passes.
